name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: Pan-India emergency response for police, fire, medical and other urgent services. Call 112 in an emergency.

name: Women Helpline
description: 24-hour toll-free support and information for women. Can connect callers with emergency services and One Stop Centres. The Ministry lists it as operational in all States/UTs except West Bengal.

name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
description: Toll-free helpline for legal aid, advice and assistance. Eligibility and local services depend on the case.

name: Tele-MANAS
description: Government of India tele-mental-health service. Call for mental health support and guidance.

name: Tele-MANAS
description: Government of India tele-mental-health service. Call for mental health support and guidance; it does not replace emergency medical care.

name: One Stop Centre referral
description: One Stop Centres can provide temporary shelter and support. Call Women Helpline 181 to ask about a local centre; services and availability are local.

name: Shakti Sadan
description: Integrated relief and rehabilitation homes for women in distress. Admission is by referral through a One Stop Centre or police station; check the official page for state-wise information.
contact: Referral through local One Stop Centre or police

name: Mission Shakti, Nagaland (information)
description: Official Nagaland Department of Social Welfare information page for Mission Shakti. For women needing immediate support, call Women Helpline 181; confirm local service availability with the department.
contact: 181 for women helpline; department contacts are on the official page
